data.title: Senior Engineering Manager
data.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.

We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN

We are a small, high-output team building across a complex technical surface: consumer marketplace, provider-facing scheduling tools, interoperability infrastructure, revenue cycle tooling, and AI-augmented workflows. We don't scale headcount to scale output. We scale leverage through AI-native development practices, tight feedback loops, and engineers who own outcomes rather than tickets.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead a cross-functional engineering team and remain a hands-on contributor. We expect roughly 30% of your time to be spent writing code, reviewing architecture, or directly shaping technical decisions. This is not a role for someone who wants to move fully into management. It's a role for someone who finds that combination energising.

You will report to our CTO and partner closely with Product, Operations, and Data to ship the systems that run our business. You are expected to be genuinely AI-native: not just comfortable with AI tooling, but actively shaping how your team uses it. That means deploying agents, building evaluation frameworks, and coaching engineers to work at a level of throughput that wasn't possible two years ago.

As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers across multiple product domains, owning velocity, process, performance, technical growth, and team culture

  • Remain a consistent technical contributor by writing production code, leading design reviews, and pairing with engineers on complex problems.

  • Define and enforce engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing discipline, deployment practices, and incident response

  • Drive the team's AI-native operating model by identifying where AI agents can replace or accelerate engineering workflows, building evaluation frameworks to measure output quality, and coaching engineers to leverage AI tooling as a primary development instrument rather than an occasional aid

  • Partner with Product to refine roadmaps, push back on scope where necessary, and ensure the team is working on the highest-leverage problems at any given time

  • Own the architecture of your team's systems by making build vs. buy decisions, managing technical debt deliberately, and ensuring the stack can support the growth trajectory of the business

  • Contribute to Scan.com's broader engineering culture through interview loops, cross-team design reviews, engineering all-hands, and the institutional knowledge that makes a small team punch above its weight

WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE

You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

  • Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams in a startup environment. You have operated with limited resources, changing priorities, and a high bar for individual output, and you have thrived in that context.

  • Genuine AI-native fluency: you have deployed AI agents in production engineering workflows, you understand evaluation frameworks and can design them for non-trivial tasks, and you have coached teams to use AI as a primary tool rather than a novelty. Candidates who cannot speak concretely to this will not be competitive

  • Active technical contributor with strong engineering fundamentals. You write production-quality code in at least one modern backend or full-stack language, can lead a system design discussion at a senior level, and have not been out of the code for more than a year

  • Experience in a scaling healthcare technology company is a strong plus. Familiarity with the regulatory environment, interoperability constraints, and the operational complexity of healthcare delivery meaningfully shortens the ramp

  • Strong cross-functional instincts: you have partnered effectively with Product and Operations, understand how to negotiate scope without burning relationships, and can represent technical constraints to a non-technical audience without losing fidelity

  • A track record of growing engineers. ICs on your previous teams have been promoted, expanded their scope, and credited you with material development in their careers

  • High ownership orientation: you do not wait to be asked, you do not manage up problems without a proposed path forward, and you treat the business outcomes of your team's work as personally yours

A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here. To be successful at Scan.com you must embody our values.

HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU

We keep our interview process short and sweet, and we're a nimble team that can progress at pace. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order of each step depending on team availability:

  1. Introductory call/interview with our Senior Talent Partner. The call is via telephone and lasts around 30 minutes.

  2. Should it feel like there is an initial fit for all, we will invite you to a video call with the hiring manager for around 45 minutes. This is a more structured interview that will deep-dive into the role and technical needs.

  3. 'Scan Standard' interview, where our panel screens for values alignment and the success factors that matter at Scan.com. You will also be assessed on your AI fluency at the stage and depth relevant to your role (see AI Requirements above).

  4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, length varies depending on how many interviewers, and whether in person or via video call.

  5. Offer!

WHAT WE OFFER

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

  • Salary range of $180,000 - $240,000

  • Flexible remote or hybrid work options

  • Dedicated personal development budget

  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage

  • 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best

  • Paid parental leave

  • 401k retirement plan

  • All the equipment you need to do your best work

  • Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team

DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM

Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/senior-engineering-manager-scan-1bb4d76bd30b44cf9f3fd5e2bd9a92b5

data.title: Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA (IA conversationnelle)
data.description:
Upgrade aide ses clients à avancer dans la bonne direction grâce à des produits financiers abordables et responsables. Depuis 2017, nous avons aidé plus de 7,5 millions de clients à accéder à plus de 42 milliards de dollars en crédit à la consommation. En nous concentrant sans relâche sur l'amélioration du bien-être financier de nos clients, nous développons des produits qui leur permettent de faire des économies et qui les soutiennent pour un meilleur avenir financier. Nous sommes soutenus par certains des meilleurs investisseurs dans le domaine de la technologie et avons été récemment valorisés à 7,3 milliards de dollars.

Nous sommes constamment reconnus pour notre culture de collaboration et d'inclusion. Plus récemment, nous avons été classés parmi les Premières entreprises fintech au monde par CNBC, Meilleurs lieux de travail par Built In, et par le San Francisco Business Times, Meilleurs lieux de travail d'Amérique par Newsweek, Meilleur employeur ''Startup'' par Forbes, et Employeurs les plus sains par Phoenix Business Journal.

Nous recherchons de nouveaux membres d'équipe qui sont enthousiastes à l'idée de concevoir et de proposer des produits nouveaux et meilleurs. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à bâtir un meilleur avenir financier pour des millions de personnes.

À propos du rôle

Un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA est responsable du cycle de vie complet des parcours que nos clients vivent avec l'agent IA d'Upgrade par clavardage, par téléphone et par courriel : création, optimisation, gestion des cas particuliers et augmentation du taux de résolution autonome. Cette personne conçoit des parcours dans les outils sans code de Sierra, collabore avec les groupes produits d'Upgrade pour intégrer leurs processus de service à l'agent, et répond de la capacité de l'agent à résoudre le problème du client de façon sécuritaire, exacte et sans intervention humaine.

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA pour prendre en charge l'agent IA d'Upgrade destiné à la clientèle. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes de développement, de produit et des opérations clientèle. Vous transformerez des processus de service, comme effectuer un paiement, consulter les détails d'un prêt, mettre à jour une adresse ou activer les paiements préautorisés, en parcours de production, et vous continuerez à les améliorer après leur lancement.

Vous concevrez et gérerez les parcours de A à Z, de la première ébauche jusqu'à leur pleine maturité. Le travail est à la fois celui d'un bâtisseur et d'un analyste : concevoir le parcours, gérer les cas particuliers, lire les transcriptions et augmenter continuellement le taux de résolution autonome. Le taux de résolution autonome, la satisfaction client (CSAT), la qualité des transferts et le taux d'hallucination sont vos indicateurs clés. Au cours de votre première année, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille de parcours couvrant l'ensemble de nos produits (prêts personnels, carte, paiement différé (BNPL), marge de crédit hypothécaire (HELOC), dépôts) et contribuerez à établir les normes selon lesquelles Upgrade conçoit, teste et déploie ses expériences IA.

Nos technologies principales

Sierra Agent Studio (parcours sans code), simulations et analyse des conversations Sierra, API GraphQL et REST (comme outils de parcours), Genesys (transfert vers le centre de contact), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Claude et autres outils de LLM.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Création de parcours : Concevoir et développer des parcours Sierra dans Agent Studio pour le clavardage, la voix et le courriel, de la phase de découverte avec les opérations jusqu'au déploiement en production
  • Optimisation : Analyser chaque semaine les transcriptions, les enregistrements et les données analytiques, repérer où les conversations échouent ou sont transférées, et déployer des correctifs à la logique des parcours, aux instructions et à la base de connaissances
  • Gestion des cas particuliers : Cartographier les scénarios problématiques (paiements refusés, identité non concordante, comptes en souffrance, demandes non prises en charge) et s'assurer que chacun se conclut par une réponse exacte ou un transfert fluide
  • Résolution autonome : Assumer la responsabilité des cibles de résolution autonome et de CSAT pour chaque parcours, mener des déploiements progressifs (1 % → 100 %) et prioriser les travaux ayant le plus d'impact sur ces indicateurs
  • Partenariat produit : Collaborer avec les groupes produits (prêts personnels, carte, BNPL, dépôts) pour définir la portée de nouveaux parcours, maintenir les parcours à jour au fil de l'évolution des produits et définir les API dont l'agent a besoin
  • Sécurité et conformité : Appliquer l'authentification à plusieurs niveaux et la vérification renforcée, le libellé de conformité exact ainsi que des garde-fous contre les hallucinations et les réponses non conformes aux politiques
  • Transferts : Concevoir les transferts vers des agents humains dans Genesys avec des résumés exacts et le contexte d'authentification
  • Tests : Créer des suites de simulation et de tests de régression afin que chaque modification de parcours soit déployée avec la preuve qu'elle n'altère pas le comportement existant
  • Surveillance : Suivre la latence, les erreurs et les abandons dans SumoLogic et Grafana, et être responsable des alertes
  • Optimisation vocale : Latence, phrases de transition, interruptions, personnalité et ton
  • Relation avec Sierra : Agir à titre de responsable technique de notre côté, faire remonter les problèmes liés à la plateforme et orienter les demandes relatives à la feuille de route

Ce que nous recherchons

  • De 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel, ou une expérience équivalente dans des rôles en solutions techniques, en IA conversationnelle ou en gestion de produits techniques
  • Connaissance pratique du comportement des agents LLM : instructions, appels d'outils, récupération de connaissances, et les points de défaillance de chacun
  • Expérience dans la conception d'évaluations pour des systèmes non déterministes : jeux de tests, simulations, LLM évaluateur (LLM-as-judge), seuils de régression
  • Une maîtrise technique suffisante pour lire des spécifications d'API, collaborer avec des développeurs backend sur des intégrations REST et GraphQL, et raisonner sur les autorisations et les portées de permissions
  • Un esprit axé sur le produit et le client : vous comprenez les procédures opérationnelles, lisez les transcriptions, accordez de l'importance au ton et mesurez votre réussite selon la résolution du problème du client
  • Sens des responsabilités en production : déploiements, surveillance, analyse de journaux et réponse aux incidents
  • Rédaction claire et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs non techniques des équipes des opérations, de la conformité et des affaires juridiques

Atouts supplémentaires

  • Expérience pratique de Sierra Agent Studio ou d'une plateforme d'agents sans code comparable (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)
  • Expérience en IA vocale : reconnaissance vocale (speech-to-text), synthèse vocale (text-to-speech), optimisation de la latence, gestion des interruptions (barge-in)
  • Connaissance des systèmes de centre de contact tels que Genesys et de la conception de transferts vers des agents
  • Expérience en fintech ou dans un autre secteur réglementé (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)
  • Expérience en conception conversationnelle ou en rédaction UX

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Salaire compétitif ($140K-$180K) et plan d'options d'achat d'actions
  • Assurances médicales, dentaires et de la vue payées par l'entreprise
  • Congés payés flexibles
  • Possibilités de croissance et de développement professionnel
  • Congé parental payé
  • Initiatives de santé et de bien-être

Exigence linguistique

English language is required for this position, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.

L'anglais est requis pour ce poste, puisqu'il comporte des interactions avec le personnel des bureaux d'Upgrade à l'échelle internationale.

Conditions environnementales et de travail

Le travail s'effectue à l'intérieur dans un environnement au rythme soutenu qui exige la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de respecter les processus de travail, les horaires et les attentes en matière de service établi.

Les employés saisissent, extraient et échangent régulièrement des informations avec précision à l'aide de systèmes et d'applications numériques afin d'appuyer les objectifs opérationnels et de service à la clientèle.

Le poste exige la capacité de recevoir et d'échanger des informations avec les clients, les collègues, les superviseurs et les partenaires interfonctionnels par le biais des moyens de communication disponibles, qui peuvent inclure des réunions, des courriels, des appels téléphoniques et des outils de collaboration numériques, et peut impliquer des échanges en temps réel, verbaux ou en personne selon les besoins de l'entreprise.

Les fonctions peuvent inclure la gestion d'un volume élevé d'interactions entrantes et/ou sortantes avec la clientèle ainsi que d'activités de travail à l'aide de systèmes de télécommunication et informatiques. Le poste exige la capacité de lire, d'analyser et d'interpréter les informations affichées à l'écran d'ordinateur et de maintenir une posture de travail pendant de longues périodes, conformément aux exigences du poste.

Le travail peut s'effectuer dans un centre de contact, un bureau ou en télétravail, selon les besoins de l'entreprise et la nature du poste. Les environnements de travail sur place peuvent inclure des espaces de travail partagés, un éclairage de bureau standard et un bruit de fond modéré typique des environnements de service à la clientèle ou opérationnels.

Les employés en télétravail sont responsables de maintenir un espace de travail sécurisé et productif avec une connexion Internet fiable qui prend en charge les systèmes de l'entreprise et protège la confidentialité des informations de l'entreprise et des clients.

Des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables peuvent être mises en place pour permettre aux personnes qualifiées vivant avec un handicap d'exercer les fonctions essentielles du poste, conformément à l'Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) et aux lois étatiques et locales applicables.

Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et nous valorisons la diversité au sein de notre entreprise. Nous ne faisons pas de discrimination fondée sur la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'âge, l'état civil, le statut d'ancien combattant ou le statut de handicap.

Upgrade n'accepte pas les candidatures spontanées soumises par des agences de recrutement, des cabinets de recherche de personnel ou toute autre tierce partie. Tout CV soumis à un employé d'Upgrade sans accord écrit préalable en vigueur sera considéré comme la propriété d'Upgrade, et Upgrade ne sera pas tenue de payer des bonus de recommandation ou de placement. Les agences doivent obtenir une approbation écrite au préalable du service d'acquisition de talents d'Upgrade pour soumettre des candidatures, et ce, seulement si une entente valide et dûment signée est en vigueur.

data.title: Senior Software Developer (Databases)
data.description:
Role Overview

When radiologists receive the right study at the right time, patients get answers faster, and behind every worklist, search, and assignment is a database that has to respond quickly and correctly. As a Senior Software Developer focused on the data layer of our InteleOrchestrator team, you’ll modernize the SQL Server-backed platform that streamlines radiology workflows for healthcare providers around the world. You’ll write the code that changes the database: refactoring schemas and queries, untangling legacy data-access code, and moving it to type-safe, well-tested patterns while the system stays live for clinicians. This is a hands-on software development role, not a database administration role; your time will be spent in code, query plans, and pull requests rather than in backups, patching, or server operations. Success in this role means faster, safer, and more maintainable data access that reduces clinical burden and gives time back to the clinicians who depend on it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex database refactoring across a large, mature SQL Server schema, including restructuring tables, keys, and indexes, retiring legacy structures, and backfilling and normalizing data, delivered as safe, incremental, version-controlled migrations (e.g., Liquibase) with no disruption to clinical users.
  • Diagnose and resolve performance problems at the source by reading execution plans, rewriting queries to be sargable and set-based, replacing row-by-row processing with batched writes and properly indexed temp tables, and designing covering and filtered indexes based on real workload evidence.
  • Modernize the data-access layer by migrating legacy and inline SQL in PHP and C# code into type-safe Kotlin and jOOQ repositories, preserving behavior through characterization, regression, and scale testing.
  • Harden data access for security and reliability by eliminating SQL injection through parameterization and automated checks, establishing consistent locking, isolation, and query-timeout conventions, and building query attribution and diagnostics that trace database load back to the code responsible for it.
  • Build the tooling that makes database change routine, including migration and upgrade pipelines in Gradle and CI/CD, containerized SQL Server test environments, and automated checks that catch regressions before release.
  • Shape technical direction by defining SQL and data-access standards, documenting conventions, and contributing to architecture decisions and the InteleOrchestrator technical roadmap.
  • Partner with and mentor fellow developers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance, helping application teams write efficient, safe database code and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including 4+ years in which writing and refactoring database code (SQL, schemas, and data-access layers) for production systems was a core part of the role.
  • Expert-level T-SQL on Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, temp tables, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, and set-based design; PostgreSQL experience is also valued.
  • Proven track record of incrementally refactoring a large, legacy relational schema and the application code that depends on it while in production, not only greenfield database design.
  • Proficiency in Kotlin or Java, or an equivalent language, building backend services with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework.
  • Hands-on experience with database migration and version-control tools such as Liquibase or Flyway, treating schema as code within Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of concurrency, locking, isolation levels, and transactional integrity, and how they affect application behavior under load.
  • Solid grounding in secure data-access practices, including SQL injection prevention and safe handling of sensitive patient data.
  • Experience delivering in agile teams using Gradle, Git, and modern DevOps practices across Windows and Linux environments.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with jOOQ or similar type-safe SQL libraries and code generation from database schemas.
  • Experience reading, maintaining, and porting legacy application code in PHP and/or C# (.NET).
  • Experience with database testing approaches such as Testcontainers or Docker-based SQL Server environments, golden-master or characterization tests, and load or scale testing of queries.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server diagnostic tooling (Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events) and observability platforms such as Datadog or New Relic.
  • Experience with AWS data services such as Amazon RDS for SQL Server.
  • Experience working with healthcare data standards such as HL7 and DICOM, or building software in other regulated industries (e.g., FDA- or FAA-regulated environments).
  • Location: This role is open to candidates based in the United States or Canada.

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Applicants may be required to complete an online technical and/or personality assessment as part of your application.

The base pay for this position ranges from $100,000 to $135,000/yr CAD within any geographic market in Canada. Pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. Bonus and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, retirement, PTO, and/or other benefits.

Intelerad is committed to the principles of equal employment. We are committed to complying with all federal, state and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and all other employment laws and regulations. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). data.description:
Summary

Guidewire’s Professional Services InsuranceSuite Practice partners with P&C insurers across the Americas to implement our cloud, digital, and core applications so they can modernize, scale, and serve their customers with confidence.

As a Senior Architect in the InsuranceSuite Practice based in Brazil, you will act as a lead technical authority on complex InsuranceSuite implementations, combining deep product expertise with hands-on design and technical leadership across architecture, integration, performance, and cloud delivery. You’ll work closely with customers, partners, and internal teams across LATAM to define implementation patterns, reduce delivery risk and effort, and drive measurable business value from Guidewire’s platform.

Job Description

What you’ll do

  • Lead end-to-end solution and technical architecture for complex Guidewire InsuranceSuite programs (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter) in LATAM, from inception through go-live and stabilization.
  • Translate customer business requirements into scalable, maintainable implementation designs spanning configuration, integration, data, and cloud operations.
  • Own critical design decisions (data model, integration patterns, performance and resiliency approaches, extensibility) and ensure alignment with Guidewire best practices and reference architectures.
  • Guide and review detailed technical designs, configuration approaches, and integration specifications produced by project teams and partners, ensuring consistency and quality.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership: troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, and data layers; perform design and code reviews; mentor architects and consultants.
  • Define and champion reusable patterns, accelerators, and implementation best practices that reduce effort and improve quality across InsuranceSuite implementations in the region.
  • Collaborate with Product, R&D, and Cloud teams to provide field feedback, influence roadmap, and align customer solutions with Guidewire Cloud Platform capabilities.
  • Proactively manage technical risks and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, resilience, security) throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Contribute to estimation, scoping, and planning for proposals and delivery engagements, including effort, risk, and dependency assessment.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer and partner technical leaders, facilitating architecture workshops and clearly documenting decisions and rationale.

What you’ll bring

Required

  • Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and data-driven insights to improve how you design, build, and troubleshoot complex systems.
  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise software implementation or architecture, including several large-scale transformation or core system projects.
  • 4+ years of hands-on Guidewire InsuranceSuite implementation experience (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter), including configuration and integration.
  • Strong expertise in at least one of: Gosu, Java, or similar object-oriented languages, plus solid understanding of REST/SOAP integrations, messaging, and batch processing.
  • Proven experience designing end-to-end architectures covering configuration, integrations, data migration considerations, and non-functional requirements.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (ideally Guidewire Cloud Platform, AWS or Azure), including environments, deployments, and operational concerns.
  • Strong understanding of P&C insurance concepts (policy, billing, claims) and how they map into InsuranceSuite.
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills: able to lead technical workshops, explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, and document decisions clearly.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum or hybrid delivery environments on distributed teams.
  • Advanced English communication skills (written and spoken); ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders.
  • Based in Brazil with the ability to work remotely and align to LATAM customer time zones; occasional travel for customer or internal workshops as needed.
  • Spanish and/or Portuguese language skills in addition to English.

Preferred

  • 4+ years of hands-on Guidewire InsuranceSuite implementation experience (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter), including configuration and integration.
  • Prior experience in a Senior/Lead Architect role on multi-year, multi-vendor core system or large program implementations.
  • Guidewire certifications (InsuranceSuite, Integration, Cloud) and/or cloud certifications (AWS, Azure).
  • Experience with performance tuning and scalability for InsuranceSuite (profiling, query optimization, batch performance, environment sizing).
  • Experience defining and/or building reusable accelerators, frameworks, or tools for Guidewire implementations.
  • Experience coaching and mentoring architects/consultants and providing feedback on design quality and implementation approaches.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development, knowledge tools, or automation to accelerate design, analysis, or troubleshooting.

Your impact

In your first 6–12 months, you will lead architecture for one or more strategic InsuranceSuite programs in LATAM, de-risking critical design decisions, improving solution quality, and accelerating time-to-value. Over time, your patterns, assets, and mentorship will uplift the broader InsuranceSuite Practice and partner ecosystem, directly supporting Professional Services’ goals of reducing implementation effort, scaling cloud adoption, and delivering measurable value for our customers.

About Guidewire

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.

Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

data.title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer | Node.js, AI-Native (Boosters R&D)
data.description:
Boosters — це українська продуктова компанія. Ми створюємо глобальні продукти в сферах EdTech, Productivity та Wellness, які несуть цінність для 60 мільйонів людей. Для нас важливо будувати продукти з довготривалим впливом — системні, масштабні та здатні залишатися актуальними десятиліттями.

Можливо, ти вже знаєш наш флагманський продукт JustDone або спін-оффи — Avrora та Promova.

Тепер ми запускаємо новий продукт у сфері персональної цифрової безпеки та шукаємо Full-Stack Product Engineer, який долучиться до команди на ранньому етапі. Основна метацієї ролі - збільшувати ревеню компанії через розробку та розвиток продуктових фічей, які допомагають залучати нових користувачів і довше утримувати існуючих.

Твоє майбутнє середовище

Ти приєднаєшся до невеликої інженерної команди, де кожен має реальний вплив на продукт і власну зону відповідальності. Тут не буде багаторівневої бюрократії чи готових рішень — ти зможеш самостійно будувати інфраструктуру, розвивати ключові фічі та разом із Tech Lead визначати технічні підходи.

Працюватимеш пліч-о-пліч з Олександром, Нікітою та Сергієм.

Лідер напрямку — Олександр Лісік, General Manager. Для Саші важливо, щоб розробник мав достатньо свободи у своїй зоні відповідальності, тому тут немає мікроменеджменту. Натомість є довіра, відкритий діалог, регулярний двосторонній фідбек і постійний пошук нових підходів до роботи. Окремий фокус - активне використання AI у щоденній роботі та обмін інженерною експертизою.

Ми свідомо будуємо середовище без технічних компромісів. Працюємо з AWS, використовуємо best-in-class інструменти та готові інвестувати в сервіси, які допомагають команді швидше створювати якісний продукт.

Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш

  • 📌 Можливість будувати, а не підтримувати legacy - ти приєднаєшся до продукту на ранньому етапі, де більшість технічних рішень ще можна приймати з нуля.
  • 📌 Реальну автономію в технічній зоні - матимеш власні задачі та відповідальність, самостійно прийматимеш рішення без зайвої бюрократії.
  • 📌 Можливість працювати над складними backend та infrastructure задачами - від архітектури й системного дизайну до AI-інфраструктури та власних технічних рішень для продукту.

Твоя зона впливу

  • Брати участь у розвитку фічей на всіх етапах - від ідеї та дизайну до розробки, релізу й аналізу результатів.
  • Аналізувати ринок і конкурентів, знаходити цікаві рішення та пропонувати нові фічі для продукту.
  • Розробляти та розвивати backend і продуктові фічі, а за потреби - працювати з frontend частиною продукту.
  • Разом із Tech Lead обговорювати архітектурні рішення та підходи до побудови систем.
  • Проєктувати та розвивати інфраструктурні рішення для продукту.
  • Розвивати AI-native engineering environment, який дозволяє команді використовувати агентний кодинг та самостійно й безпечно розробляти й запускати рішення.
  • Підвищувати стабільність, надійність і масштабованість технічних рішень.

Для цього тобі знадобиться

  • Від 4 років досвіду в backend-розробці або Full-Stack із фокусом на backend. А також для нас важливий досвід роботи в продуктовій компанії.
  • Впевнений досвід Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Досвід frontend-розробки на React або Next.js з TypeScript.
  • Глибоке розуміння PostgreSQL, Redis та проєктування REST API.
  • Розуміння software architecture та system design.
  • Практичний досвід роботи з AWS, Docker та CI/CD.
  • Досвід написання автоматизованих тестів (unit/integration/e2e).
  • Активне використання AI-інструментів та агентного кодингу (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex або аналогів).
  • Значною перевагою буде досвід побудови технічної архітектури та інженерних процесів на ранніх етапах розвитку продукту.

Твій шлях до команди Boosters

Pre-screen з рекрутером (45 хвилин) → Soft Skills + Pre-Tech Interview (75 хвилин) → System Design Interview (60 хвилин) → Bar-raising (60 хвилин)

Ми пропонуємо

Кар’єрний та персональний розвиток

  • Планові performance review і розробка PDP;
  • Підтримка в розвитку твого персонального бренду в соцмережах Boosters і експертних медіа;
  • Профільні комʼюніті Genesis з безкоштовними курсами і можливістю нетворкінгу;
  • Бюджет на курси, конференції та вивчення англійської;
  • Техніка від компанії та оплата всіх необхідних сервісів для роботи.

Автономію та гнучкість

  • Гнучкий старт дня (з 8 до 11 ранку);
  • 20 дей-офів на рік, вихідні на державні свята та безлімітні лікарняні.

Турботу про здоров’я

  • Медичне страхування;
  • Компенсація роботи з психологом;
  • Індивідуальний бенефіт на заняття спортом;
  • Сніданки й обіди (on-site в офісах);
  • Спортивні активності Genesis: cпільнота для бігу, волейбол, йога (офлайн); стретчинг та йога (онлайн).

Виглядає як твій наступний карʼєрний крок? Надсилай своє CV!

А якщо маєш рекомендацію для цієї або будь-якої іншої ролі — залиш її ТУТ :)

data.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Engineering at Qualified is a high-ownership, high-velocity environment where engineers ship customer-facing product to real enterprises at scale. We're building at the frontier of AI + product: developing agentic software and embedding AI directly into our platform, using modern toolchains and processes that help engineers move faster while staying focused on high-impact problem solving.

Following our acquisition by Salesforce, we continue to operate with the pace and ownership of a startup—backed by the distribution, resources, and long-term runway of a global enterprise. Engineers have true end-to-end ownership from idea to production: scoping, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement based on real customer feedback, without layers of approvals slowing you down.

The Role

As an engineer on the Data Team, you'll operate as a technical leader on the layer everything else is built on. The team owns Qualified's data end to end: leads and accounts data models, ETL pipelines, Data 360, Salesforce sync, analytics and insights, data integrations, and Data APIs. Every product area and every AI agent we ship depends on this layer being correct, fresh, and fast.

This is a newer team with real greenfield ahead. You'll shape the architecture of core pipelines and data models, set patterns that other teams build against, and turn a set of inherited systems into a coherent platform. You'll also play a direct role in Piper's intelligence: her ability to reason, personalize, and act is bounded by the data she can see, and the enterprise deals we're closing depend on how confidently that data moves between Qualified and Salesforce.

What You'll Do

  • Design and ship data systems end-to-end: models, pipelines, sync, and serving layers that the whole platform builds on
  • Drive technical design for high-volume, multi-component systems (ETL, event streaming, analytics stores, APIs) with an emphasis on correctness, freshness, and operational excellence
  • Own Salesforce data flows at enterprise scale
  • Build the analytics and insights infrastructure that powers customer-facing reporting and internal decision-making
  • Define data quality standards: SLOs, data contracts, observability, and the tooling to enforce them
  • Own delivery from scope/design through launch, monitoring, and iterative improvement—anticipating risks, sequencing work, and aligning stakeholders
  • Partner closely with product teams and engineering leadership to make data a first-class platform capability
  • Raise team effectiveness through mentoring, technical guidance, code review, and improving standards, tooling, and processes

Who You Are

data.description:
Penguin Ai: We're Not Just Building AI, We're Revolutionizing Healthcare! Want to Be Our Staff Engineer Maestro?

Who We Are: The Penguin Ai Rebellion!

We’re not your average AI company - and we don’t want average teammates. Penguin Ai was founded by healthcare veterans who knew the system needed more than hype and half-baked algorithms. We built an AI platform that actually works in healthcare - across Prior Auth, HCC Coding, and all those soul-crushing workflows no one brags about. Our platform is fast to implement (think: 60 days), reduces administrative costs up to 40%, and makes payers look like heroes without writing a line of code.

This is AI for the real world of healthcare. And just to put a fine point on it: powerhouses like Snowflake and AWS don't just partner with anyone. Their trust in our platform speaks volumes about our robust, scalable, and secure technology.

Our audacious vision was first ignited by ourCEO Fawad Butt, whose leadership asChief Data Officerat bothOptumandKaiser Permanentegave him oversight of healthcare data representing nearly75% of American lives. So, he didn't justseethe problem; helivedit. Fawad understood that healthcare AI couldn't be a bandage - it had to be apurpose-built, battle-ready solution, meticulously crafted for the intricate, human-first world of medicine, not some hastily retrofitted industry software.

So with Fawad, who else is steering this iceberg? A dream team boastingover 150 years of combined, hard-won healthcare experience!We're talking about heavy hitters likeKishore, Niki, Dan and Nate… who all bring different successes & expertise from AI & healthcare.These aren't just impressive resumes; they're the architects and masterminds behind a platform that doesn't just process data – it genuinelyunderstands healthcare's pulse.

We're growing faster than a penguin on a waterslide and we’re always on the hunt for customer-obsessed problem-solvers to help our clients unlock the full potential of their AI investments.

This isn’t some futuristic sci-fi movie set, this is AI for the real, gritty, essential world of healthcare where speed & data matter.

Your Epic Quest as Our Staff Engineer

The Staff Engineer finds the problems worth solving and sees them through. They drive technical direction with their own ideas and the evidence to back them, set the standard for technical quality from the code they write to the systems running in production, make AI a reliable part of how engineering work gets done, and raise the level of the engineers around them and of those we hire.

Your Day-to-Day Superpowers: What You’ll Actually Do:

  • Solve the problems that matter:Identify what limits how fast the business can move, advocate for solutions with the people who own the decision, and drive the agreed fix through, working with the owners of every system involved
  • Lead projects end to end:Delegate so others grow, step in when anyone is stuck, and own the whole team’s output, crediting the team and taking problems on yourself first
  • Set technical direction:Set engineering direction alongside other technical leaders, proactively defining the tools, libraries, and practices used across departments, and champion the group’s decision even when your own proposal loses
  • Build the evidence:Build the measurement when the data doesn’t yet exist, along with a clear account of the alternatives and trade-offs
  • Design in the open:Share designs early & rough and write down why decisions were made and what was unknown at the time
  • Ship on the hardest problems:Ship code on the team’s hardest problems, seeking out the difficult work, and review promptly, challenging the code and never the person
  • Own production:Own what runs in production: its reliability, operability, and long-term health. Prevent incidents by building in observability and tested recovery, and fix root causes
  • Take charge when things break:When anything goes wrong in production, take ownership at once, whoever’s system it is. Communicate early and calmly, drive the fix to completion, and review systems and decisions, never individuals
  • Make AI a reliable part of engineering:Use AI throughout your work and answer for its output as your own. With your peers, define where it can be trusted, where it needs closer review, and what must always be verified, so results are consistent across engineers
  • Represent engineering:Represent engineering to internal and external customers as a confident technology leader: prepared, plain about trade-offs, and bringing the team along
  • Coach and grow engineers:Coach engineers toward the next level of their work with direct, empathetic feedback, shared mistakes, and harder problems than they would choose themselves
  • Hold the hiring bar:Hold the bar for engineering talent, judging candidates and colleagues alike on evidence against the same standard, including how each treats ideas and people

What We're Looking For: Your Engineering Solving Arsenal!

  • You meet each need with the simplest solution that will serve it, and weigh every problem against business priorities, deferring those that don’t yet warrant the effort
  • You surface risks, slips, and your own mistakes the day you see them, arriving with a proposed way forward rather than blame
  • You drive technical direction with your own ideas and the evidence to back them
  • You welcome challenge, hold your position against objections the evidence doesn’t support, and revise publicly when proven wrong
  • You engage technical disagreements rather than avoid them, keeping debate on ideas and escalating early when agreement can’t be reached
  • Your code and designs are correct, tested, secure, and maintainable, and you never take on technical debt without naming its cost and owning a plan to repay it
  • Expert level in using AI Coding tools: Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Codeium etc
  • You say “I don’t know” openly, then learn it and apply it
  • You continually look for better practices and retire those that no longer hold up
  • English fluency - spoken and written

Bonus Points: Your Secret Weapons!

  • You’ve delivered AI or automation projects that deliver measurable undeniable impact
  • You've not just survived but thrived in the beautiful chaos of a high-growth startup
  • You can effortlessly translate between product-speak, clinical-speak, and exec-speak
  • You have a legendary reputation for turning "red" projects gloriously green

The Culture Fit: Join Our Colony!

You'll waddle with us if:

  • You like your coffee with a side of delightful chaos
  • You're fuelled by complexity and obsessed with delivering amazing results
  • You want to deliver something that fundamentally matters, transforms healthcare and ultimately saves lives
  • You believe implementation isn’t a handoff; it’s the start of an epic, trusted partnership!

Education & Qualifications: Brainiac Basics

  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field

Comp & Perks: Because Even Superheroes Need Support!

  • Competitive salary: We reward greatness!
  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage: Keep you healthy and smiling!
  • Generous vacation policy and company holidays: Recharge and conquer!
  • A front-row seat in one of healthcare's most exciting AI companies – witness history in the making!

data.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: This individual must be based in either Eastern or Pacific Time in the US. or willing to work during these time zone work hours

Opportunity
Deepgram is seeking a talented, support-focused Solutions Architect (Applied Engineer) to join our Applied Engineering (AppEng) team. In this role, you will directly engage with customers to solve complex technical challenges while simultaneously building scalable solutions that enhance our support infrastructure. You'll own complete customer engagements in a post-sales capacity, and occasionally assist with pre-sales and implementation projects as needed. Your strong engineering background will enable you to resolve sophisticated technical issues, create repeatable solutions, and develop automation that allows the broader AppEng team to focus on high-impact pre-sales activities. This position offers an excellent path to grow into broader implementation and pre-sales roles while making an immediate impact on our customer support experience. As a key member of the Applied Engineering team, you'll influence our customer support strategy, and play a crucial role in ensuring our customers receive exceptional technical assistance throughout their journey with Deepgram.

About Applied Engineering at Deepgram
The Applied Engineering (AppEng) team at Deepgram combines the functions that other companies might separate into Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Implementation, and Technical Support. We serve as the technical interface between Deepgram and our customers throughout their entire journey, from initial discovery and proof-of-concept, through implementation and onboarding, to ongoing technical support. We work closely with our Customer Success and Developer Experience (DX) teams to ensure a positive, growth-focused experience for our customers. This unified approach allows us to provide comprehensive technical guidance and build deeper relationships with our customers. As a support-focused Applied Engineer, you'll be primarily concerned with elevating our technical support capabilities while having opportunities to contribute to the broader Applied Engineering mission in pre-sales, implementation, and more.

What you'll do

  • Own the technical design and delivery of customer implementations and migrations, from kickoff through production cutover

  • Lead deployment scaling work, including capacity planning, rollout sequencing, and verification methodology

  • Design solutions that fit each customer's existing stack, constraints, and operational shape

  • Partner with Customer Success and Account Executives on customer-side change management, including readiness, stakeholder alignment, and rollout communication

  • Develop reusable implementation patterns, reference architectures, and deployment playbooks that the broader AppEng team and customers can reuse

  • Create automation and self-service tooling that compresses time-to-value for repeatable implementation work

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and influence the roadmap based on patterns observed in active deployments

  • Provide support for the most complex post-onboarding cases when escalation crosses into Solutions Architect territory

  • Occasionally support pre-sales technical work, including discovery, scoping, and proof-of-concept design

Time allocation

  • 50% — Customer implementation and scaling engagements

  • 20% — Building reusable patterns, reference architectures, and automation

  • 15% — Pre-sales technical support, including discovery, demos, and proof-of-concepts

  • 10% — Documentation and knowledge sharing

  • 5% — Complex post-onboarding escalations and collaboration with Technical Support Engineers

Your first 90 days

  • First 30 days — Complete comprehensive onboarding to understand Deepgram's technology, products, and the patterns we use for implementations. Gain proficiency with our core APIs and documentation. Shadow active implementation engagements to build familiarity with how the AppEng team operates during customer change phases.

  • 60 days — Begin owning customer implementation engagements end-to-end, leading technical design and partnering with Customer Success on rollout. Start contributing to reusable implementation patterns and reference architectures.

  • 90 days — Own the technical delivery of multiple concurrent customer implementations. Develop and deliver scalable solutions for repeatable customer change patterns. Begin contributing to the Applied Engineering team's implementation methodology and mentoring newer team members.

You'll love this role if you...

  • Enjoy seeing customer technical environments transformed through careful implementation work

  • Are passionate about reducing the time it takes any customer to reach production value with Deepgram

  • Find satisfaction in designing patterns that scale beyond a single customer engagement

  • Have a talent for identifying recurring needs across customers and translating them into reusable artifacts

  • Are energized by deploying cutting-edge Voice AI in production environments with real customers

  • See implementation work as a strategic function that drives customer growth and retention

It's important to us that you have

  • 3+ years of experience implementing or deploying technical solutions for enterprise customers, ideally in customer-facing technical roles

  • Strong software engineering background with professional development experience in at least one modern programming language, such as Python, JavaScript / TypeScript, Rust, C / C++, or similar languages

  • Experience leading technical delivery of production deployments, from design through cutover

  • Proven ability to scope complex technical work and sequence it for successful delivery

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to engineering and business stakeholders alike

It would be great if you had

  • Experience with speech recognition, natural language processing, AI Voice agents, or related AI technologies

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with API-first products and developer tools

  • Background in change-management or implementation methodology

  • Experience producing reference architectures, deployment playbooks, or implementation templates

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're growing fast and hiring the Engineering talent to match.

You'd be joining our Mobile team within the Platform Engineering division. We treat our internal developer platform as a real product, with internal customers (our feature teams, 150+ developers) and adoption metrics.The mission for this role: make it dramatically faster and safer to ship mobile features at MaintainX.

Today, feature teams reinvent patterns, fight with build infrastructure, and ship slower than they should because the foundations underneath them are inconsistent. We want a mobile foundation where feature teams stop thinking about CI, release trains, shared components, and observability, they just build features.

What you’ll do:

  • Design, build, and maintain mobile React Native foundations and tooling powering our internal developer platform.

  • Lead to the consolidation and evolution of platform primitives: SDKs, CI pipelines, build tools, local development golden paths.

About you:

  • Strong AI mindset

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Senior Backend Engineer to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.

Backend Systems Engineer

Job Title: Backend Systems Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Experience: 6+ years
Salary: 100k - 150k
Sponsorship: No new H1B sponsorship available. H1B transfers welcomed for qualified candidates.
Employment Type: Full-time, direct W2 with Bright Vision Technologies (no C2C, no 1099, no third-party)
Engagement: Long-term, multi-year, aligned to the Bright Vision SOW delivery roadmap
Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus benefits.

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.
We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.

BUT STRICTLY NO C2C/1099/3RD PARTY COMPANIES. ALL OUR ROLES ARE W2 AND NO 3RD PARTY BROKERING PLEASE.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.
No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.

However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.
For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Backend Systems Engineer with deep expertise in distributed systems to design, build, and operate large-scale, high-throughput backend services that power mission-critical workloads. In this role you will architect the core platforms that other engineering teams build on, focusing on scalability, reliability, performance, and clean engineering practices. The ideal candidate will combine strong fundamentals in computer science with practical, battle-tested experience operating distributed systems at scale, and will be comfortable navigating the trade-offs between consistency, availability, and latency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement large-scale distributed backend systems using Java, Go, Scala, or similar high-performance languages.
  • Architect data partitioning, replication, and consistency strategies appropriate to each workload’s requirements.
  • Build resilient APIs and event-driven services with strong observability, idempotency, and graceful degradation patterns.
  • Optimize systems for latency, throughput, and cost, using profiling, benchmarking, and load testing.
  • Lead detailed architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and trade-off analyses.
  • Implement robust failure-handling patterns including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, bulkheads, and saga workflows.
  • Design and operate data stores at scale, including relational, key-value, document, and search engines.
  • Build comprehensive observability into services with structured logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
  • Drive incident response and post-incident learning for critical backend services.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and lead by example in code quality, design, and operational rigor.
  • Partner with SRE and platform teams to drive reliability improvements and reduce operational toil.
  • Contribute to long-term architecture and platform strategy, helping shape multi-year technical roadmaps and ensuring near-term execution remains aligned with the broader engineering direction.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Six or more years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant time on distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Java, Go, Scala, or similar.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including consensus, replication, and CAP trade-offs.
  • Hands-on experience with high-throughput message systems such as Kafka.
  • Experience operating systems at scale, including capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and mentorship skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading complex technical initiatives across multiple teams.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms in production.
  • Exposure to service-mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd).
  • Familiarity with chaos engineering practices and tools.
  • Open-source contributions to relevant distributed systems projects.

data.description:
Location Designation: Fully Remote

Role Overview:

The Data Exchange Specialist is responsible for managing the overall process, practice, and project implementation of electronic data interfaces with New York Life clients in support of Life, Accident, Disability, Family Medical Leave products, and various service offerings, with a strong focus on National Accounts and highly complex data integrations.

This role serves as both a technical and consultative resource, ensuring high-quality data exchange while educating clients on how their data powers downstream services including administration, billing, eligibility, enrollment, and reporting.

The Specialist understands how data flows through New York Life systems—from file receipt and validation to internal processing and operational impact—and proactively advises clients and TPAs on how data structure, file dependencies, and transmission timing affect service delivery and administration outcomes. They balance New York Life standards regarding layout, data integrity, and transmission protocols with client requirements to deliver compliant, scalable, and efficient solutions.

The Data Exchange Specialist manages multi-file data environments where multiple client files must be validated, sequenced, reconciled, and merged in order to support accurate system ingestion. These integrations often involve complex file structures, dependent file relationships, and conditional data mapping logic, requiring advanced technical expertise in file architecture, merge capabilities, and data validation.

This role also drives inventory control of active interfaces and milestone management in partnership with internal and external stakeholders. The Specialist demonstrates strong analytical capabilities to audit incoming files across multiple data sources, identify discrepancies or systemic errors, and implement corrective actions that improve data integrity and client experience.

The Data Exchange Specialist partners closely with Implementation IT, Family Medical Leave Operations, Account Management, and external Ben Tech vendors to ensure deadlines are met, key milestones are achieved, and implementation efforts stay aligned with business objectives.

Because this role supports large National Accounts and marquee clients, it requires the ability to manage high-volume, complex integrations with multiple vendors, benefit programs, and file dependencies. The Specialist must proactively assess data risk, ensure data governance standards are met, and maintain operational stability across interconnected systems.

Additionally, they act as a leader among peers by proactively contributing expertise, mentoring team members, taking on complex work, driving process improvements, and independently leading projects and training initiatives.

What You'll Do:

  • Integrate with TPAs and Ben Tech partners in support of eligibility, enrollment, remittance, and billing data for new and inforce business.
  • Serve as a consultative partner to clients and TPAs by educating them on data structure, file specifications, and the operational impact of their data across downstream administration systems.
  • Implement complex electronic interfaces based on established timelines while maintaining strict inventory control of active integrations, dependent file streams, and in-flight implementations.
  • Manage multi-file integration environments, ensuring files are received, validated, and sequenced appropriately for system ingestion and downstream processing.
  • Review, audit, and validate test data across multiple related files and data sources to ensure quality, completeness, and alignment with business rules prior to production implementation.
  • Identify root causes of file discrepancies, mapping errors, transmission issues, or data inconsistencies across merged files, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Understand and articulate end-to-end data flow, including how files are received, validated, transformed, merged across multiple sources, and processed within New York Life systems.
  • Balance New York Life/LDEX standards regarding layout, data, and transmission protocols with client requirements, delivering compliant and scalable solutions for complex client environments.
  • Prepare and maintain documentation confirming the method of data exchange between New York Life and client/TPA, including file dependencies, mapping logic, merge requirements, and audit controls.
  • Partner with Production Support and IT to ensure successful receipt, mapping, merging, and processing of data.
  • Articulate complex file mapping and merge logic requirements clearly to IT and technical partners.
  • Drive accountability with internal teams and Ben Tech partners to meet key deliverables and milestone deadlines.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to electronic data exchange, multi-file integrations, and system processing impacts.
  • Track file status and ensure metrics are reported accurately within Salesforce.
  • Develop and maintain support documentation, SOPs, and training materials for complex integration processes and data governance practices.
  • Proactively review and suggest improvements to existing procedures to enhance efficiency, data integrity, and scalability of complex integrations.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for complex data exchange implementations and National Account integrations, providing guidance and mentorship to peers.

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s Degree strongly preferred or minimum of 3 years relevant work experience required.
  • Prior experience working with clients, producers, TPAs, or Ben Tech partners preferred.
  • Strong understanding of complex data structures, file layouts, and electronic transmission methods preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze, audit, and interpret complex and high-volume data files, including multi-file data environments.
  • Experience managing file dependencies, merge logic, and reconciliation across multiple data sources preferred.
  • Strong planning, project management, and inventory control skills.
  • Proficient/advanced Microsoft Excel skills required (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Macros).
  • Proficiency in Access preferred.
  • Experience with mainframe TSO and JCL scripting preferred.
  • Excellent organizational skills with ability to manage multiple complex implementations simultaneously and meet tight deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal and consultative skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive results and meet key milestones.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across internal business partners.
  • Demonstrated leadership capability in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Proven adaptability and willingness to embrace change and continuously improve processes.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $70,000-$90,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

data.title: Software Engineer, SMS Adapter
data.description:
About Ottimate

Ottimate is an AI-powered AP [Accounts Payable] automation platform that empowers finance teams to reduce costs, prevent overpayments, detect fraud, and enforce policy compliance across the entire invoice-to-payment lifecycle.

About the Role

Ottimate is expanding into the retail and grocery market. There, invoice and vendor data live inside store-level systems, such as POS, back-office, and inventory platforms like BRdata, rather than the ERPs we integrate with today.

The SMS Adapter makes that data usable: a secure connector that runs at the store or corporate office, pulls data directly from the store's system, and syncs it to Ottimate's AP platform. We're looking for a software engineer to own this adapter end-to-end, from the initial data connection and sync logic through to the security, reliability, and deployment experience that lets a non-technical store operator run it with confidence.

This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy role. You'll be one of the first engineers dedicated to this product line, working closely with the retail/grocery product owner and store-side IT contacts at pilot customers.

Rsponsibilities

  • Build and maintain the adapter that connects to in-store systems, starting with BRdata, and syncs invoice items, vendor, and PO data to Ottimate.
  • Design and harden a reliable sync process: delta and full syncs, retry and backoff behavior, conflict handling, and clear failure visibility when a store's network or data source is unreliable.
  • Own local data handling and credential storage so the adapter can run unattended and securely on a store's machine.
  • Build and improve the setup and monitoring experience that store staff and support use to configure connections, check sync health, and troubleshoot issues without engineering involvement.
  • Establish strong automated test coverage for the adapter and keep it reliable across all target deployment environments (Windows is the primary target).
  • Own packaging, updates, and installation for software running on store-owned machines, often behind restrictive IT policies.
  • Work directly with pilot retail/grocery customers to diagnose environment issues, such as network, permissions, and data access, and turn them into product and reliability improvements.
  • Define and evolve the adapter's data model and mapping layer as we onboard additional store systems beyond BRdata.

Requirements

  • +5 YoE in strong software engineering experience, with a track record of owning a product end-to-end, from the data layer through the user-facing experience.
  • Experience building and shipping software that runs on end-user machines, including the packaging and distribution concerns that come with that.
  • Solid database experience, including comfort reverse-engineering schemas in third-party systems you don't control.
  • A track record of writing dependable integration and sync code: idempotency, retries, partial-failure handling, observability.
  • Practical testing instincts. You know when to reach for integration and end-to-end tests, not just unit tests, to catch real-world failure modes like a flaky store network or a locked-down machine.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity. This is a new, fast-moving product area without years of established internal convention to lean on.
  • Bonus: Prior experience with retail/grocery back-office systems, POS integrations, or field-deployed software supporting non-technical end users.

Why This Role

You'll be the engineering owner of a product that's foundational to Ottimate's entry into a new market. The work you ship directly determines whether retail and grocery customers can get their invoice data into Ottimate at all. You'll have significant latitude to shape the adapter's design, testing strategy, and roadmap as the product line grows.

Benefits

Benefits

We care deeply about making Ottimate an incredible place to work and invest a significant amount of time and energy into creating and maintaining a company culture that provides our team with a generous level of support whilst inspiring them to do their best work.

The specific benefits/perks we offer are continually evolving, but currently include:

  • Compensation: $160,000-180,000 USD /year.
  • Competitive salary based on skills & experience.
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and other Company-Subsidized Benefits for you and your family.
  • Employer sponsored 401(k) with company match.
  • Paid Time Off (and the encouragement to use it).
  • Promote from within philosophy.

Beyond the tangible benefits though:

  • You will be part of a growing team, at a pinnacle moment of scale for the business, and experience the excitement of working in a startup where each action makes a huge difference.
  • You will have the agency to solve difficult problems creatively, the freedom to explore work that inspires you, and infrastructure to ensure you're constantly challenged and developing.
  • You will work with sharp, passionate teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and positioning our product as a premier finance automation solution.
  • Our commitment to empowering a diverse and inclusive workforce, celebrating differences, and creating a safe space for our employees to bring their whole selves to work is second to note.
  • We are transforming entire industries using innovative technology including Artificial Intelligence, Payment Tech, and Neural Networks.
  • Our leaders lead with a people-first approach; inspiring excellence, nurturing ideas, and finding creative ways to eliminate obstacles for cultivating growth.
  • We truly love what we do and who we do it with - and we think you will too!

Ottimate is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or marital status. If you are excited about the role but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. Nothin
